summary: More than most people, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you build things that last and carry real weight, you think for yourself and break the mold. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: More than most people, a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough and a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you build things that last and carry real weight, you think for yourself and break the mold. It rewards you when you reach for it. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
gift: At your best: you build things that last and carry real weight, and you think for yourself and break the mold.
shadow: The trap: you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes — or you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control.
integration: Let discipline and limits and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Innovation inside structure works; an either-or stance stalls.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you build things that last and you think for yourself work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
